title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability in which JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled JNDI-related endpoints, allowing for remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: For all affected software assets for which updates exist, the only acceptable remediation actions are: 1) Apply updates; OR 2) remove affected assets from agency networks.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache HTTP Server contains a path traversal vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Struts Jakarta Multipart parser contains a remote code execution vulnerability.
OpenSSL contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the TLS heartbeat extension.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spring Framework JDK 9+ Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution.
